releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.13
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.13

This alpha update adds a floating game window and automatic Android keyboard support. It also reduces background CPU use and fixes several touch and graphics issues.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Floating game window** is on by default. When you switch apps, the game can keep playing in Android's picture-in-picture window, capped at 20 FPS. Tap the window and use its expand button to return to full screen. You can turn it off in Settings. The background setting is now called **Keep running in background**.
- The Android keyboard opens when a WoW text field gains focus and closes when you finish typing. It stays closed while a hardware keyboard is connected.
- The game surface requests 60 Hz while you play, including during touch input, to reduce display power use on high-refresh-rate phones. WeHavePhones also cleans up leftover Wine processes shortly after a session ends.
- **Disable WoW voice chat** is on by default to reduce background CPU use. Turn it off in Settings if you use WoW's built-in voice chat.

## Touch controls

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.12
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.11
releases.body:
An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

## What's new

- Added 75%, 90% and 110% touch interface sizes. The movement stick, toolbar and other native touch controls now resize with the interface, at a gentler rate to keep them easy to tap.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.10
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.9
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on Forever touch controls, launch frame pacing and diagnostics.

Install over 0.0.8 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install it for you.

## What's new

- Battle.net and the launch screens now run at 30 FPS to reduce rendering work before WoW starts. The cap lifts automatically when WoW starts, so gameplay is unaffected.
- Diagnostics now includes Android's recorded reasons for recent app exits, helping identify low-memory closures and crashes. Available on Android 11 and later.
- Added experimental Turnip Gen8 V38 as a manual graphics driver choice on Adreno 7xx phones.

## Touch control fixes

- Forever now receives the touch layout, with chat, player frames and hotbars positioned clear of the touch buttons.
- Forever's controller and gamepad interface now turn off when launching with touch controls. Turning touch controls off restores your previous controller settings on the next launch.
- Fixed "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" errors caused by the Forever touch layout during combat.
- Fixed Forever's hidden quest tracker and quests disappearing when selecting a target.

releases.name: 3.0.6 - November 18, 2026
releases.body:
* Fixed GB, GBC and GBA games running slow on PAL (576i) 50Hz output
* Fixed JIT IRQ latency bug causing graphical artifacts
* **Restored the original controls of the games with special Wii controls** (Zelda, Mario, Metroid, Ninja Turtles, Mortal Kombat, Star Wars, Harry Potter, Medal of Honor, Boktai, The Lord of the Rings, Castlevania and the rest). The input refactor had rewritten them as a single layout for every controller, which lost things like the Nunchuk's C fast-forward and the D-pad items in the Zelda games, the D-pad punches and kicks in Mortal Kombat, and shoot and jump on A and B in the Metroid games. * **A Wiimote with anything plugged into it is now always vertical in the menus**, and its buttons and IR pointer work alongside the extension (a Nunchuk on Wii and a Classic Controller on both Wii and Wii U previously lost them)
* **Redesigned Button Mappings screen.** One screen now replaces the separate controller and button screens, showing each button on a drawing of the controller and letting you choose a button by pressing it or from a list.

releases.name: SpartanPort 3.2.1
releases.body:
> **SpartanPort 3.2.1: the game opens again on NVIDIA cards on Windows, textures no longer get corrupted over time, and the wall seam fix reaches every game release.** Updating from 3.2.0 through the launcher keeps your saves and settings. These notes list every change since 3.2.0, the requests it closes and what is still open.

## Updating from 3.2.0

- **Windows:** update through the launcher as usual, or download `spartanport-windows.zip` from this release.
- **Linux:** download `spartanport-x86_64.AppImage` from this release and replace the old file.
- **Settings carried over:** everything you set in 3.2.0 stays.
- **NVIDIA players who unticked "Use pipeline binary cache (A/B test)"** to start 3.2.0 can tick it again in **Launcher > Performance > Shaders**. If the game still closes at start, untick it and tell us in #1352.

## NVIDIA cards on Windows open the game again (#1367)

- **Before:** on every NVIDIA card on Windows, 3.2.0 closed one or two seconds after **Play** with "code 3", the log ending at `Fault: read access to 0000000000000010 at spartanport-probe.exe+0x2d643b`.

> **SpartanPort 3.2.0: shaders prepared on the first start, brightness, contrast, gamma and HDR10, any engine frame rate from 30 to 240, cheats in the launcher, RecompLauncher support, and crash fixes for RX 570/580 cards and integrated GPUs.** Updating from 3.1.0 through the launcher keeps your saves and settings. These notes list every change since 3.1.0, the requests it closes and what is still open.

## Updating from 3.1.0

- **Windows:** update through the launcher as usual, or download `spartanport-windows.zip` from this release.
- **Linux:** download `spartanport-x86_64.AppImage` from this release and replace the old file.
- **Settings carried over:** everything you set in 3.1.0 stays, including your engine frame rate. Brightness, contrast and gamma start at the values that leave the picture exactly as before.
- **HDR:** if **Allow HDR output** was already on in the launcher, the game now really uses it: with Windows HDR on for that display, the picture comes out in HDR10. Turn the option off to keep SDR.

# VKRT NES Remaster v0.1.0-rc.1

**First public preview — Windows x64 and experimental Linux x86-64**

VKRT NES Remaster is an open-source, native C++20 Nintendo Entertainment System emulator developed by Francisco Triemstra (VKRT).

It features a first-party NES emulation core with CPU, PPU, APU, cartridge and mapper implementations, alongside an observation-driven visual remastering system.

The remastering pipeline is designed to enhance presentation without changing the canonical emulation state.

## Games Supported: Metroid, Super Mario Bros. 3, Ninja Gaiden 3.

## Downloads

### Windows x64 — Tested Preview

- Native Windows desktop application.
- Original (F1) and Remaster (F4) presentation modes.
- Keyboard and controller support.
- Audio, fullscreen, ROM loading and save-state functionality.
- Built with MSVC 19.44.
- **41/41 automated tests passed, 0 failures.**
- Functional testing confirmed by the project owner.

**Installation:** Download the Windows ZIP, extract it and launch `VKRT NES Remaster.exe`.

### Linux x86-64 — Experimental

- Native C++20 Linux executable using X11/XWayland.
- Original (F1) and Remaster (F4) presentation modes.

releases.name: GenX v1.1.4
releases.body:
Fixes for the games reported on GitHub, PlayStation controllers, and the
Master System's Light Phaser and paddle.

**Download:** `GenX-v1.1.4-win64.zip`. Unzip it anywhere and run `genx.exe`.
To update, replace your old `genx.exe` with the new one. Your settings and
saves stay where they are.

### New

- **PlayStation controllers.** A DualShock 4 or DualSense is recognised and
  laid out like an Xbox pad, with its own button names in the Input tab. A
  DualShock 3 works through DsHidMini.
- **Automatic controller choice.** GenX uses whatever pad is plugged in, and
  the keyboard when there's none. New installs start on it; pick it in
  **Configure → Input** if you already have settings.
- **Master System Light Phaser and Paddle Control**, aimed with the mouse,
  plugged in by themselves for the games that need them.
- **Light gun games get their gun by themselves**, on the Mega Drive and the
  Sega CD.

### Fixed

- **Pier Solar** now plays and saves.
- **Back to the Future Part III (Europe)** starts on the Master System and
  the Mega Drive. Other European games that need a 50Hz console get one.
- **50Hz games no longer run 20% fast**, including Fantastic Dizzy.

releases.name: GenX v1.1.3
releases.body:
Play your real Sega CD discs. Nothing else in the emulation changed.

**Download:** `GenX-v1.1.3-win64.zip`. Unzip it anywhere and run `genx.exe`.
To update, replace your old `genx.exe` with the new one. Your settings and
saves stay where they are.

### New

- **Sega CD discs straight from your PC's CD/DVD drive.** Put the disc in,
  choose **File → Open ROM → Sega CD from drive**, and pick the drive. GenX
  reads the game and its CD music from the disc, reading ahead while you play
  so the drive keeps up. A USB drive works too.
- **Changing discs:** use **Sega CD → Swap to disc in drive**, or just put the
  next disc in the drive. GenX swaps it in as a real Sega CD would.
- **Front ends:** `genx.exe E:\` starts the disc in drive E:.

You still need the Sega CD BIOS for the disc's region.

If your drive or a disc doesn't work, please
[open an issue](https://github.com/GamesExObscura/GenX/issues) with the drive's
make and model and the game.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/GamesExObscura/GenX/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for every change.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe isn't code-signed.
Choose **More info → Run anyway**.

releases.name: GenX v1.1.2
releases.body:
Sega CD fixes. Nothing else in the emulation changed.

**Download:** `GenX-v1.1.2-win64.zip`. Unzip it anywhere and run `genx.exe`.
To update, replace your old `genx.exe` with the new one. Your settings and
saves stay where they are.

### Fixed

- **Crash when opening a Sega CD disc.** GenX closed without a message when a
  disc sat near a file or folder whose name has certain characters, such as an
  accent stored as a separate mark (some "Pokémon" names) or Japanese text.
- **Japanese and Southeast Asian Sega CD BIOSes now start.** They used to stop
  on an error such as "This is a PAL-compatible Mega CD for exclusive use in
  Southeast Asia", because GenX always presented itself as a US or European
  console. GenX now becomes the console the BIOS belongs to.
- **Japanese discs get a Japanese BIOS** when your BIOS folder also holds the
  Southeast Asian one. Some BIOS packs name the Southeast Asian BIOS
  `jp_mcd1_9112.bin`, which GenX used to pick first.
- The **BIOS** tab in **Configure** shows the BIOS each region's discs will
  really use.

Thanks to the player who reported the Southeast Asia error.

releases.name: Lumen Emu 0.1.0 (5) — iOS / iPadOS preview
releases.body:
# Lumen Emu 0.1.0 build 5 for iOS and iPadOS

This preview targets ARM64 iPhones and iPads running iOS or iPadOS 17.4 or later. The IPA is intended for sideloading and local signing with AltStore Classic. Both the PS4 and PS5 cores require JIT. Installing this build and enabling JIT through AltStore Classic still need to be verified on a physical iPhone.

## Installation and JIT setup

1. [Install the IPA with AltStore Classic](https://github.com/gs-soft-it/lumen-emu/blob/main/README.md#install-the-ipa-with-altstore-classic)
2. [Enable JIT on iPhone](https://github.com/gs-soft-it/lumen-emu/blob/main/README.md#enable-jit-on-iphone)

## Core changes

- The PS4 core uses FFmpeg for AAC decoding and Mbed TLS 3.6.7 for HTTPS. Apple Security verifies certificate trust and hostnames.
- The PS5 core uses the project's SPIR-V transformations for its native Metal renderer on iOS.
- The on-device JIT component is built from StikJIT 2.0.1 and `idevice` 0.1.68 using RustCrypto and a pinned `Cargo.lock`. The separate JIT extension uses AGPLv3. Dependency provenance and license notices are in the source archive and in `Legal/stikjit` inside the IPA.

## Testing and compatibility

releases.name: Lumen Emu 0.1.7 — Direct library access, audio fixes & updated core
releases.body:
**Lumen Emu 0.1.7, build 10** updates the GitHub APK with a quick folder browser, direct access to your existing game library, PS4 audio fixes and the latest cumulative core changes.

### Library and interface

- Choose your game folder quickly and use its files in place after granting Android’s all-files access. No private copy is required for the GitHub APK.
- Preserve the selected folder from earlier direct-access GitHub releases, together with existing settings and saves. The one-time folder reset used by the Play migration is skipped on GitHub.
- English dashboard and folder-selection flow, with an expanded compatibility catalog.
- Updated device-specific compatibility reports in the README, including developer-reported West of Dead version 01.00 on realme GT 8 Pro. Reports remain tied to their stated device and tested build.

### Audio and core

- Improve NGS2 streamed PCM audio, buffer completion callbacks and voice-state queries. The corrected path restored audible Brotato audio in the documented Android development test.

releases.name: Lumen Emu 0.1.6 — Faster loading, Banners & automatic PanVK
releases.body:
## Massive loading improvements and experimental Mali support

**Lumen Emu 0.1.6 brings a massive loading speedup in the tested PS5 startup path, restores direct local-ROM access for both PS4 and PS5, bundles Turnip Banners, and adds automatic experimental PanVK selection for compatible Mali GPUs.**

### Faster loading

- Local ROM folders now use direct filesystem reads after granting Android's all-files access, avoiding repeated document-provider work during loading.
- The system folder picker remains available. Recognised local filesystem folders use the direct path; other supported providers retain the document bridge.
- Document-backed libraries also benefit from reduced path lookups, provider acquisition and directory-enumeration overhead, plus improved native file-size queries.
- The single active library and optional verified folder moves are preserved.

releases.name: Lumen Emu Android 0.1.2-spike-fexlab — build 3
releases.body:
## 0.1.2-spike-fexlab — Android version code 3

27 October 2026 · [Release and APK](https://github.com/gs-soft-it/lumen-emu/releases/tag/v0.1.2-spike-fexlab)

### Changes

- Import the entire prepared library with Android's system folder picker into a private copy, with a space check, progress and cancellation. The source remains unchanged and can be disconnected after import.
- New imports create separate libraries without merging contents or automatically synchronising source changes. Existing shared-storage selections require an explicit re-import.
- Remove broad storage permissions. Clarify that content must already be extracted: the app does not open, extract or install PKG files.
- Include the current common-runtime fixes for shared memory, graphics resources, shader compilation/rendering and Android surface recovery, preserving the adopted defaults and leaving withdrawn experiments disabled.
- Show the active graphics driver in the included SUCCI benchmark result.

# reNut Android 0.4.0

An experimental Android port of **Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts** (Xbox 360), built from a static recompilation of the game.

> **Heads up:** this is a vibe-coded port. Expect bugs, rough edges and uneven compatibility across devices.

## Features

- **Local multiplayer** for two players: connect a second gamepad and it joins as player 2.
- **No GPU command-stream emulation.** The game's Direct3D calls are translated straight into Vulkan through Plume, the same renderer layer UnleashedRecomp uses, with shaders recompiled ahead of time. Some Xbox 360 GPU behaviour (resolves, texture formats, tessellation, memexport) is still emulated on the host.
- **In-app achievements** section.
- **Graphics options** to trade quality for performance:
  - internal resolution
  - texture resolution
  - shadow resolution
- **Adrenotools driver support**, a bundled Turnip driver and Turnip tuning options.
- **Save import and export.**

## Performance

On a Galaxy S23 Ultra the game runs above 30 FPS at the original graphics settings. Other devices have not been tested, so your results will vary. If it runs slowly, lower the internal, texture and shadow resolution.

releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for [issue 39](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/39): on a phone with an Exynos 2400, the Android app shows the same graphics message at every start once Anti-Aliasing is set to 8x. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is the code that will become 1.1.8, as it stands today. When the phone cannot make a picture buffer at the settings chosen, the port lowers a setting and asks for a restart. 1.1.7 only ever lowered Super Sampling, so with Super Sampling already at 1x nothing changed and every start ended the same way. This build lowers one setting each time: Super Sampling, then Anti-Aliasing, then Color Depth, then Render Scale. It never asks for an Anti-Aliasing level the phone does not offer, it remembers a level that failed, and the log names the levels the phone offers.

Install it over 1.1.7. Saves stay. If 1.1.7 left the phone stuck, the first start of this build should lower Anti-Aliasing to 4x by itself and get into the game. If it still stops, attach `snap64.log` from Internal storage > Snap64 to issue 39.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test4 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is [1.1.7-test3](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test3) with a fix for the crash that build recorded. The Thor's graphics driver crashed at the end of the first drawing pass of the first frame. That pass held a reset of the renderer's timers, which Vulkan does not allow inside a drawing pass. The port's own clear of new picture buffers had left the pass open. Now the reset, and the two other steps Vulkan keeps outside a drawing pass, close an open pass first. The log says so once.

The crash record from test3 stays in. If the app still closes, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test3 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It does not fix the crash. It records it. [1.1.7-test2](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test2) answered the first fault on the Thor, a table of textures the driver refused. The app still closes a moment later, and the log has no line for it. This build writes the reason into `snap64.log`:

- When the app closes on a fault, it writes the signal, the thread, the graphics call that thread was in, and the code addresses.
- At the next start, it copies in Android's own report of how the last run ended.

To help: install it over what you have, open it, let it close, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test2 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is 1.1.7 with one file of the renderer changed. On a Qualcomm graphics driver, the renderer's table of textures now gets its full declared size, and on any driver a table that is refused is asked for once more. Three guards came with it: a refused table is no longer written to, and clears and scissors are kept inside what Vulkan allows. The log says more about what the driver answers. The change is attached as `plume-issue36.patch`.

The APK is signed with the project's key, so it installs over 1.1.7 and saves stay. Android's app info shows it as 1.1.7-test2.

It has been checked on Android's emulator only. The same game code passed the Android checks, 114 of 114. The signed file installed over 1.1.7 with its files kept, and passed the fix's own check, which plays the Qualcomm driver's rule, 23 of 23. It has not run on a Thor yet. That is what this build is for.

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: 0.3.1 Seamless Connection
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。

releases.name: 0.3.0 Experience Enhancement
releases.body:
## 升级须知

> [!CAUTION]
> **Android 务必先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.3.0 的备份位置和格式都变了，不再读取旧备份。

## 新功能

- **传输时可以删除目标多出的文件。** 目标有来源没有的文件时，传输页会出现“保留/删除”开关。
- **备份可以直接管理。** 两端的备份都改成文件夹，按 `游戏名/UTC 时间` 存放。移动端放在 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/`，可以用能访问该目录的文件管理器查看和删除；电脑端可以从备份页打开文件夹。

- **适配平板。** 屏幕最短边不小于 600dp 的设备支持横竖屏，主导航移到左上角，内容限制最大宽度，游戏列表按宽度增加列数。手机固定竖屏。
- **两端互看传输进度和结果。** 无论从哪一端发起，两端都能看到进度和逐项结果，也可以取消传输。每个游戏都能查看最近的传输。
- **写入中断提示。** 写入途中应用被关闭时，下次打开会提示文件可能不完整；有备份时可以直接跳到备份。
- **目录失效提示。** 目录被改名或授权失效时，游戏设置页的目录行会显示警告并提供“重新选择”。

- 手机传输页重新设计，高亮展示两端文件差异，按新增、减少、覆盖、保留等着色。

releases.name: 0.1.1 E2E Expansion
releases.body:

> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

### Faster

- **Up to 7% more frames a second, with nothing to set.** The renderer copies less between its
  render targets: when a draw is about to cover an area completely, the old picture there is no
  longer copied in first. The picture is unchanged.
  - At the King's Camp, the game went from 42.0 to 44.8 frames a second.
  - With FSR 3.1 Balanced, it went from 34.0 to 35.3.

**Options -> Visual -> Eco shading** trades a little sharpness in the 3D scene for speed: the
scene's colours are worked out once for each two pixels (**Light**) or each block of four

  post-processing.

  and cloth.
- **It needs a GPU driver with variable-rate shading.** The Thor's own driver has it. On a
  driver without it, the option changes nothing.

| Eco shading | FSR 3.1 off | FSR 3.1 Balanced |
|---|---|---|

releases.body:
Fixes the ConsolePort wizard reappearing on every login ([reported on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/EmulationOnAndroid/)).

If you interacted with the addon's controller-setup wizard during your very first login, WoW saved a half-finished configuration that blocked the automatic setup from ever applying — so the wizard kept coming back. The app now re-checks your account every time you press PLAY and repairs that state automatically (your previous file is kept as `ConsolePort.lua.bak`).

**If you were affected:** update, exit the game completely, press PLAY again. The wizard should be gone and the full pad mapped.

Also clarifies the first-login instructions shown in the app. Non-English clients (frFR, deDE, …) are fully supported — the locale was unrelated to this bug.

releases.name: WoW Mobile v0.1.1
releases.body:
First public release.

**WoW Mobile** runs World of Warcraft 3.3.5a (Wrath of the Lich King) on Android with touch controls designed for [ConsolePortLK](https://github.com/leoaviana/ConsolePortLK). It is a single-purpose fork of [Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) (LGPL-2.1).

## Install
1. Download and sideload `wow-mobile-v0.1.1.apk` (installs alongside stock Winlator — separate app id `it.wowmobile`)
2. Put your own WoW 3.3.5a (build 12340) client folder on the phone's storage — **no game files are included**
3. Open the app → allow storage → *Select game folder* → PLAY

On first launch the app installs the bundled ConsolePortLK addons, calibrates the bindings, sets the realmlist (changeable in WoW Settings) and creates a tuned Wine container. After your first login, log out once so it can finish per-account calibration — then everything just works.

## Highlights
- One-tap play: folder validation, addon install, key bindings, realmlist and graphics config are all automatic and idempotent — an already-configured folder is never damaged

The app now re-checks your account every time you press PLAY and repairs that state automatically (your previous file is kept as `ConsolePort.lua.bak`).

**If you were affected:** update, exit the game completely, press PLAY again. The wizard should be gone and the full pad mapped.

Also clarifies the first-login instructions shown in the app. Non-English clients (frFR, deDE, …) are fully supported — the locale was unrelated to this bug.

# PokePark 2: Wonders Beyond, PC and Android port (beta) 0.1.2

No game data is included: you need your own copy of the game (USA, S2LE01).

## Downloads

- **Windows** (10 or 11, 64-bit; Vulkan 1.3 or OpenGL 3.3): unzip and run PokePark2.exe. Keep the prompts and tools folders, SDL3.dll and vcruntime140.dll beside it. If you're updating, unzip over your old folder; your saves and settings stay.
- **Android** (11 or later, arm64, Vulkan 1.3): install PokePark2.apk over the previous version. Your saves stay.

## What's new

- **Many more controllers on Windows.** PlayStation (DualShock 4, DualSense), Switch Pro, 8BitDo and most other controllers now work over USB or Bluetooth, read through SDL3, alongside Xbox ones. - **Aiming with the stick.** Where the game uses the Wii Remote's pointer, the right stick now moves it slowly near the middle, for aiming, and much faster at full tilt, for turning.

## Known issues

- The Wii Remote speaker, pointer and Nunchuk aren't supported; the game doesn't need them.

releases.body:
This one is mostly about what happens *under* the 3D. The emulator itself got a lot better.

## New

**Accuracy: 147 of 147 on AccuracyCoin.** 0.5.0 passed 128. Zaxnes was also compared cycle by cycle with a transistor-level simulation of the NES chips (421,901 CPU cycles, DMA included), and the timing matched. Where the two still differ, tests made on real consoles side with Zaxnes.

**Over 400 mappers.** Up from 144. That includes the **Famicom Disk System**, the **VS. System** with its cabinet buttons, and newer boards like the Rainbow.

**A fast core.** It skips work the screen doesn't need, but gives the same results as the accurate core. We checked that frame by frame on 320 ROMs. Handhelds use it by default.

**New options window.** One slider goes from *Fastest* to *Most faithful* and sets everything that costs speed. A simple mode shows only what most people need, and an advanced mode shows everything. It works the same on the PC and on the console screen.

Zaxnes is an independent project, not affiliated with Geod Studio or Nintendo.

## Highlights

**3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 compatibility.** Profiles from 3dSen 2.0 and 2.1 import and play, with what the new versions brought: reflections, bend, the new camera and Lua features.

**A real NES emulator, not just a gimmick.** Mapper support goes from 85 to 144, and AccuracyCoin from 89 to 128 tests out of 147. More accuracy work is coming in the next releases.

**New widescreen hacks: Kirby's Adventure and Faxanadu.** Every regional version of each. Faxanadu already has its 3D profile in this release; Kirby's is on the way.

**Smooth scrolling at 120 Hz (experimental).** On a 120 Hz screen, the playfield is drawn between two emulated frames, from the run-ahead.

**RetroArch shaders.** Slang shaders (through librashader) on the Vulkan / DirectX 12 renderer: CRT, scanlines, LCD, Mega Bezel TV frames. A pack of presets is built in, separately for 2D and 3D. Available on Android too.

**Editor mode for 3D profiles (work in progress).** An AI-assisted editor: it gives an AI agent a harness through a local MCP server, and a prompt ready to copy and paste. Expect more on it in the next release.

First public release of Pocket2Droid, a Windows Mobile emulator for Android that runs the complete operating system, including compatible applications and games.

- ROM library with individual settings and persistent storage.
- Shared StorageCard folder with file importing.
- On-screen controls with adjustable transparency, vibration feedback and multi-key support.

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.43
releases.body:
## Arceus Native v0.43

### Mali (Arm's own driver): invisible characters and Pokémon (#47, #51, #54, #57, #58)
The player, Pokémon, NPCs and swaying trees are posed by a step that writes their moved vertices into memory before they're drawn. On Arm's own Mali driver that step wrote nothing: the driver doesn't let vertex shaders write to memory, so those models came out empty. Its self-test (in your log since v0.35) showed it plainly: vertex shader writes, nothing; compute shader writes, all of them.

v0.43 does that step another way on such drivers: each vertex is drawn as a single point into a hidden image, then a compute shader copies the results into place. It turns on by itself when your log says `transform feedback captures: as points into colour targets`.

Tested on a Galaxy S25+ with the new way forced on: characters, Pokémon and NPCs drawn, animations right, no crash. **It hasn't run on a Mali phone yet:** please tell us whether your characters are back, and attach `Download/PokemonLegendsArceus-log-previous.txt`.

### Also
- Nothing else changes on Adreno, Xclipse or PowerVR. `DM_VK_TF_POINTS=0` in env.txt turns the new way off, and `1` forces it on any GPU.

- **A crash in the engine's own code on some phones** (#46). Some of the game's threads have a stack of only 16 KB, and the engine's code ran on it when the game called into it; on some phones that ran past the end. It now runs on the thread's own larger stack.
- **A GPU crash ("device lost") now counts as a crash.** The next start then offers the safe options, instead of failing the same way every time.

releases.body:
Install over your current version: saves and setup stay.

**Fixed: the game closed at every start with 1440p on.** v0.40's Graphics → Resolution → 1440p made the game run out of its own memory for render targets, which is sized for 1080p. v0.41 ignores that setting and hides it, so if you picked 1440p, just install this and play. Introduce the new termux-ui module with a unified graphical interface for Windows applications, Linux desktops, files, and runtime components.

- Runtime components: download and manage Wine, Box64, graphics, and supporting components, including custom Wine and Box64 builds.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.1
releases.body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

releases.name: v2.3 – Faster games, NFL Fever 2004 fix, Linux build, Performance and compatibility release: CPU boost, GPU boost, per-game settings with automatic safe mode, a fix that lets NFL Fever 2004 run, and a first Linux build
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.3
This release is about speed and game compatibility. The emulation changes are listed here so you know what touches the game itself.
CPU boost and GPU boost (Settings > General > Performance). CPU boost runs the game's SSE math on your PC's processor and trims work in the CPU emulation. GPU boost turns on faster paths in the graphics code, such as skipping textures a shader never reads. Turn either off if a game misbehaves. The ideas and some of the code come from Tovarichtch's xemu fork (branch `perf-experimental`).
Per-game settings and safe mode. Each game can have its own CPU boost, GPU boost and shader seeding, used the next time it starts (Settings > General > Performance > This game). If xemu closes unexpectedly while a boost was on, that game starts in safe mode the next time, with the boosts off, and tells you. "Leave safe mode" is in the same place.

It adds a lot of new features, and most of them have passed automated checks so far, with them being tested by me personally but NOT all of them. Please report anything that breaks on the issue tracker, with your platform and what you were doing.

## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and the `course-*` files together.
Tracks that use the new wind or CPU aggression settings save a newer settings block that 1.2.x cannot read. Tracks that do not use them stay readable by older builds. Keep your backup if you might go back to 1.2.x.

## New: G-Diffuser Companion (Windows and Linux)

The Windows x64, Linux x64 and Linux arm64 downloads now include the Companion, a separate desktop program in the `companion` folder inside your G-Diffuser folder. It builds the files G-Diffuser loads and checks every input before it builds. It never edits your settings, saves or stores.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.3 - Course Editor Hotfix
releases.body:
## Fixes
- Correct complete-course snapshot content binding so metadata-only edits do not reuse an incompatible retained snapshot.
- Handle terminal disk-write refusals without trapping Course Edit in its save wait loop.
- Fix the host editor's remaining 64-node admission ceiling. The supported total remains 127 nodes, including forks.
- Restore Content Library layout previews for supported tracks above 64 nodes.
- Adapt native load, overwrite, and delete confirmations to long filenames while keeping normal-size text and the Yes/No controls in place.
- Size the Course Edit information panel dynamically to fit the track title, length, and node count.

## Save compatibility — read before updating
Close the game and back up the complete installation save/state set before updating, not only the cartridge `.sav` file.

This release writes version-2 `.gcs` snapshots and still reads version 1. Older builds cannot read version-2 snapshots or packages that contain them. Before downgrading, restore the complete matching pre-upgrade save/state backup. Keeping old snapshots alone is not sufficient.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix
releases.body:
## G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix

- Fix disk-write ownership checks that could prevent Course Edit saves from completing and cause track imports to fail with MFS error 244.
- Preserve snapshot validation, rollback, and recovery protections during save and import operations.
- Add regression coverage using the production disk-write helper, including write failures and rollback.

Back up your installation's save and course-state files before updating. This hotfix does not change the course snapshot format.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.1 - The Small Improvements and Fixes Update
releases.body:
## Back up before upgrading

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and `course-elements.gdxs`, `course-forks.gbs`, and
`course-settings.gks` together. Do not open snapshot-backed saves in an older executable.
The new, extended tracks that go above the original 64 node limit are not compatible with the original Expansion Kit or older tools.

## Course Edit

- Widen the native course information panel at a fixed size. Keep full 20-character names on
  one row and fit three-digit node counts without moving the buttons below it. Dynamic sizing
  is deferred.

- Raise the combined main-path and alternate-path control-point ceiling to **127**. Geometry,
  jump, effect, decoration, and junction budgets still apply; 127 points is not a guarantee
  that every layout fits.
- Add complete, content-bound save snapshots for extended courses and complete course/cup
  package sharing. Missing or mismatched required snapshot data is rejected rather than
  silently loading a truncated course.
- Keep both paths selectable after editor reload and save/reload. Show stored branch nodes

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.0 - The Big Upgrade Edition
releases.body:
1.2.0 brings G-Diffuser to macOS and Android, adds an in-game updater, and is the biggest Course Edit update so far: Mouse Controls, undo, forks, lava strips from F-Zero GX, Magnet strips for the original F-Zero, and Blender-style camera controls. Thanks to everyone in the feature requests channel who shaped it.

## Before you update

- **Coming from 1.1.0, download this release by hand.** 1.1.0 has no updater. From 1.2 on, desktop builds can update themselves.
- **To install by hand,** extract the release over your existing `G-Diffuser` folder. Your `saves/`, ROM and game data stay where they are.
- **Rebuild your ROM hack archives.** Hacks now carry more of their own data, and an archive built by an older version doesn't have it.
- **Continue Cup is per hack.** An existing `gp_resume.bin` stays with the stock game, and each hack starts with no saved cup.
- **Courses that use new features need 1.2.** Forks, magnet traps, custom music and custom elements are ignored or lost on older versions.
